title: Singing: 'I'm Gonna Sit Right Down'
summary: He sings a Fats Waller number.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Now another thing that I mentioned that you were a singer. As a matter of fact your Chicago write up said that you were a lovely singer. (LAUGHTER). I think you're an adorable person. I can't quite think of you as lovely. (LAUGHTER).
Well, his choice of words is a little....
But I just can't quite think of a karate chopper as a lovely person. (LAUGHTER). A little too delicate for him. (LAUGHTER).
No. I got over those days though.
I'm no longer a chopper. Now it's the lover style. But I like to sing.

Maybe if Marian were here she would play even though the piano's out of tune for you but I would just love to have a little bit of your style. And everybody who's listening to this knows that you're not performing.
Well, let's see. I don't know, I'm thinking of Fats Waller, here's one of the tunes... ....
Oh you made one, you used to sing, 'I'm Going To Sit Right Down......

Yes. I'm Going To Sit Right Down and Write Myself a Letter'. And I used to love the way Fats Waller used to sing that thing. Of course it swung and ( MR. MCPARTLAND BEGINS TO SING THE SONG) ...........(I'm going to sit right down and write myself a letter and make believe it came from you. Going to write words oh so sweet, they're going to sweep you off your feet. Lots of kisses on the bottom and you'll be glad you got 'em. I'm going to smile, say I hope you're feeling better baby, so we can do the things we used to do. I'm going to sit right down and write myself a letter and make believe, oh make Baby! believe, oh make believe it came from you./)
(LAUGHTER). That's real character singing. (LAUGHTER). Well yes, yes.
Well it's just having fun, thinking about your chick you know and make believe it came from you.
Oh no, I can see you must have really been fine.
I know, but that said, I can see you really performing with the band and singing in that style and just having great fun with it. Yes. Great, real character.
